headline: New Zealand Annual Inflation Eases to 3.7 Percent in Third Quarter
summary: Annual inflation in New Zealand fell to 3.7 percent in the September 2026 quarter as petrol prices dipped, though core measures remained firm.
why: Inflation prints are critical inputs for central banks when determining monetary policy adjustments and setting official cash rates.

impacts.name: New Zealand
impacts.why: Persistent core inflation pressures maintain expectations of potential central bank interest rate hikes.
